description: This file contains unit tests for static activation rebalancing in an Orleans-based distributed system, verifying that activations are correctly moved between silos without adding new activations during the test.

classes.name: StaticRebalancingTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying static activation rebalancing behavior in Orleans, using fixtures and output helpers.

methods.name: Should_Move_Activations_From_Silo1_And_Silo3_To_Silo2_And_Silo4
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that initializes activations on silos, waits for rebalancing cycles, and asserts expected activation distribution changes post-rebalancing.
